Krystyna Wells
2nd Year BSc Computer Science Student at UAL

About Me

Hi! I'm Krystyna Wells, a second-year Computer Science student at the University of the Arts London. I’m passionate about combining creativity, technology and communication, from building IoT systems to exploring AI for design and interaction. Currently, I’m the Treasurer of the FinTech Society and author of the blog Tech Trailblazers, I love collaborating on hands-on tech projects.

Leadership & Involvement

FinTech Society, UAL — Treasurer & Acting Vice President (2024 – Present)
  • Oversee society finances, budgeting, and event planning for a growing student-led FinTech community
  • Spearhead engagement initiatives and first-year outreach
  • Organize speaker events exploring blockchain, digital banking, and AI in finance
Tech Trailblazers Blog — Founder & Writer (2024 – Present)
  • Founded a blog championing women in technology through interviews, insights, and stories from the field
  • Conduct interviews with researchers and professionals
  • Write articles on AI, IoT, and gender diversity in tech
